localizations.description:
Real-time collaboration through living documents kept up to date by your AI agents.

xMatrix is a shared workspace built around live Pages. As your team and your AI agents work, specs, decisions, and current project state update directly inside the document—so everyone works from the same source of truth on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Web.

LIVE PAGES KEPT CURRENT BY YOUR AGENTS
Turn project plans, architecture notes, and next steps into living documents that update in real time as work happens. No more digging through scattered threads to figure out what changed.

EVERY DECISION TRACKED IN CONTEXT
Browse revision history, compare section edits made by teammates and AI agents, and jump straight into the discussions linked to any part of a page.

APPROVALS, AUTOMATIONS, AND INTEGRATIONS
Connect your workspace tools, receive timely notifications when work needs a decision, and approve key actions directly from your living documents.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Switch between live Pages, revision history, and active Agents with native mobile navigation, file and photo attachments, and instant push updates.

An xMatrix account and internet connection are required. Agent and integration availability depends on your workspace permissions and connected services. Optional Pro subscriptions (monthly or annual) are available through the App Store.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://xmatrix.sh/privacy
xMatrix Terms of Service: https://xmatrix.sh/terms

localizations.description:
通过实时文档，让人和 AI 智能体协同工作的共享空间。

xMatrix 以「实时文档（Pages）」为核心。团队成员和 AI 智能体围绕同一份页面推进工作，项目方案、当前状态、关键决策与待办会随进展实时写回文档，在 iPhone、iPad 与电脑上始终看到最新真相。

由智能体持续维护的实时文档
把项目规格、阶段结论和执行清单沉淀到共享页面，随着任务推进持续自动更新，不必在零散记录里翻找最新状态。

每次修订清晰可追溯
随时查看版本历史与章节变更对比，一目了然地看到团队成员和智能体改了什么，并可从任意章节直达关联上下文。

围绕文档的审批与工具联动
连接常用工作工具，在需要人拍板或授权时第一时间收到推送提醒，在手机上安全确认后结果自动回写页面。

专为 iPhone 与 iPad 打造
原生底部导航流畅切换实时文档、修订记录与智能体状态，支持原生相册、拍照与文件附件上传。

使用本应用需要 xMatrix 账号与网络连接。智能体与外部集成能力取决于你的工作区权限与已连接服务。应用内提供可选的 Pro 月度/年度订阅。

隐私政策：https://xmatrix.sh/privacy
xMatrix 服务条款：https://xmatrix.sh/terms
